title: alternanthera rugulosa
intro: Alternanthera rugulosa, commonly known as 'Red Callaloo', is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Alternanthera rugulosa are attributed to its antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
